column1: # Korg Trinity / TR-Rack multisample list (ROM index as stored in program bytes 31-34 / 168-171)
# Source: TR-Rack Ctrlr editor panel by Tom Harper, https://github.com/FRDTom/TR-Rack-Editor
#   ("Tr Rack Editor.bpanelz", zlib-compressed; Lua function loadOscNames). Names were hand-typed/OCRed by the
#   panel author from Korg's TR-Rack Voice Name List -> expect typos; spelling fixes in col 4 are ours (flagged).
# Indices 0-374 (0x000-0x176) = Trinity ROM (375 multisamples, same on Trinity/plus/pro/proX/V3).
# Indices 375-414 = TR-Rack-only additions (8MB extra ROM) -- NOT present on a Trinity keyboard.
# Validated: user programs decode to matching instruments (0 A.Piano, 104 Clarinet, 113 Alto Sax, 125 Trombone,
#   138 Bandoneon, 142/144 Voice, 149/150 Strings, 152 Violin, 159 Nylon Guitar, 186 A.Bass 2, 238 Syn Bass-TB ...).
